summary: Rebecca Knight, 26, drowned when a 4-person privately owned raft overturned on the Cache la Poudre River near Mishawaka; the other three occupants got out unharmed, Knight was retrieved downstream in Poudre Park and flown by Air Link to a hospital, where she was pronounced dead.
location: Cache la Poudre River near Mishawaka / Poudre Park
responding_agency: Larimer County (Air Link); Poudre Park firefighter assisted
notes: Distinct from id 2454 (2014-06-14 Mishawaka raft, 7 occupants, 29-yo victim); different date, party size, and location. Run 651. run 791 merge: NFN breaking-news version of the 2014-06-04 Knight private-raft fatality (13000-block Poudre Canyon, 4 occupants; initial-report age 25 vs coroner-confirmed 26).
